battle.name: 嘉定之戰
battle.brief: 1274年冬，元軍西蜀都元帥也速帶兒領水陸大軍順岷江而下，配重投石車等攻城砲具隨軍待命，渡江築浮橋、築寨合圍嘉定府城；宋安撫使昝萬壽據三龜、九頂山死守，1275年六月初一以四城降元。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 嘉定之戰是1274至1275年元朝與南宋在四川南部嘉定府（今四川樂山）之間的一場攻守戰。元軍方面，蒙古貴族出身的西蜀都元帥也速帶兒總攬全局，下轄西川行樞密院事汪良臣所領的漢軍行省體系：管軍萬戶速哥領水軍，部將石抹不老、旦只兒各率船隊與步騎，都元帥紐璘之子也速答兒領三千精兵作山地先鋒，另有西川行院副使忽敦所部。指揮上，元廷於至元十一年（1274）六月把砲手都元帥府改為回回砲手軍匠萬戶府，把配重投石車一類攻城砲具的匠人與操作手另立軍籍，歸中樞與行省兩層調度；成都一線由元帥府、行院與宿將賽音諤德齊等分掌。南宋方面，嘉定與敘州、興元同屬邊郡，四川軍政歸西川行樞密院與安撫使司，兵權集中於安撫使昝萬壽，都統侯興領三龜、九頂山的山地步兵，陳都統與鮮于團練掌水軍，知敘州李演統援軍。兩軍同屬多路樞密院體系：元軍靠萬戶、千戶、百戶的分層編制與水陸協同，宋軍則以山城據險、府州分守、援軍別置的辦法應戰。
countriesEn: The Battle of Jia Ding, fought from 1274 to 1275, was the attack on Jiading Prefecture in southern Sichuan, at modern Leshan, by the forces of the Yuan dynasty against the Southern Song. On the Yuan side the overall command belonged to Yesu Dair, commander of Western Shu and holder of the title of Grand Commander (都元帥), who was of Mongol noble descent and who directed the Han Chinese administrative and military system of the West Sichuan Branch of the Central Secretariat (西川行樞密院) headed by Wang Liangchen: the military household commander (管軍萬戶) Suge led the river fleet; his subordinates Shimo Bulao and Dan Zhi'er commanded respectively a squadron of ships and combined-arms detachments; Yesu Da'er, son of the late commander Niulin, led three thousand picked men as a mountain advance guard; and there were further troops under Hu Dun, sub-commissioner of the West Sichuan branch. On the command side the Yuan court reorganised its artillery in the very year of the campaign: in the sixth month of the eleventh year of Zhiyuan (1274) the former Siege-Engines Marshal's Office (砲手都元帥府) was renamed the Office of the Huihui Artillery Master Troops (回回砲手軍匠萬戶府), which gave the master trebuchet crews and their craftsmen a separate roll of their own, answerable both to the Central Secretariat and to the provincial authorities. In Chengdu the command was divided between the marshal's office, the branch secretariat and seasoned commanders such as Sayin Edeji. On the Southern Song side Jiading, Xuzhou and Xingyuan were all frontier prefectures, and the military administration of Sichuan rested with the West Sichuan Branch of the Central Secretariat and the pacification commissioner's office (安撫使司), the actual command in the prefecture being held by the pacification commissioner Zan Wanshou; the regional commander (都統) Hou Xing led the infantry on the heights of Sankui and Jiudingshan, Chen the regional commander and Xianyu the drill officer (團練) had charge of the river flotilla, and Li Yan, prefect of Xuzhou, commanded the relief force. Both armies belonged to a multi-branch secretariat system: the Yuan relied on the layered chain of ten-thousand, thousand and hundred-household units combined with cooperation between the fleet and the army, while the Song answered with hill redoubts, separate garrison of each prefecture and city, and relief columns posted independently.
people: 元世祖忽必烈是這場戰爭最終的決策者。襄樊於1273年陷落後，他下令全面攻宋，並令元樞密院招諭嘉定、重慶、江陵、郢、漣、海等拒兵自守的邊郡。蒙古方面，西蜀都元帥也速帶兒是全役統帥，他以七十艘巨艦、數千勇士順岷江而下，佔據嘉定府上游；管軍萬戶速哥率水軍在平康城與他會師，修寨堅守，又建懷遠寨扼守要路；部將旦只兒在夾江縣擊敗宋軍攔截；石抹不老在紅崖灘造浮橋，切斷宋軍與外界聯繫；紐璘之子也速答兒率三千精兵至三龜、九頂山察看地形，擊敗宋軍，斬首五百級；西川行院副使忽敦在紅崖灘與也速帶兒會師，接應總攻。元將賽音諤德齊此前與昝萬壽對壘，卻以誠意相待、不事侵掠，使昝萬壽心服，成為日後勸降的伏筆。南宋方面，安撫使昝萬壽是全城主帥，他依托三龜、九頂山據險固守，堅持不出；都統侯興在九頂山拒戰，1275年二月力禦而戰死；部將李立奉書請降；陳都統與鮮于團練領水軍出逃，至大佛灘全軍覆沒；知敘州李演引兵來援，得知嘉定已失便回撤，於羊雅江兵敗被俘。城破之後，元廷授昝萬壽四川行樞密院事，賜名順。
peopleEn: Kublai Khan, the Yuan emperor, was the man who finally decided this war. After Xiangyang and Fancheng fell in 1273 he ordered a general offensive against the Song, and the Yuan Central Secretariat was instructed to send sealed letters of summons to such frontier prefectures as Jia Ding, Chongqing, Jiangling, Ying, Lian and Hai, all of which were holding out against the invaders. On the Mongol side Yesu Dair, commander of Western Shu, was the overall field commander: he brought seventy large ships and several thousand men down the Min River and occupied the upper reaches above Jiading Prefecture; the military household commander Suge brought up the river fleet to meet him at Pingkang, entrenched there, and built the Huaiyuan stockade to hold the vital defile; the subordinate Dan Zhi'er defeated a Song blocking force at Jiajiang county; Shimo Bulao threw a pontoon bridge across the river at Hongyatan to cut the Song garrison off from the outside world; Yesu Da'er, son of Niulin, took three thousand picked troops to Sankui and Jiudingshan to reconnoitre the ground, beat the Song troops and took five hundred heads; and Hu Dun, sub-commissioner of the West Sichuan branch, joined Yesu Dair at Hongyatan to support the final assault. The Yuan general Sayin Edeji had earlier faced Zan Wanshou across the lines but had treated him with sincerity and had not indulged in ravaging, which won the Song commander's heart and became the prelude to the later surrender. On the Southern Song side the pacification commissioner Zan Wanshou was the commander of the whole city: he relied on the heights of Sankui and Jiudingshan, held the ground stubbornly and refused to be drawn out. The regional commander Hou Xing fought at Jiudingshan and was killed there in the second month of 1275. The subordinate Li Li carried a letter offering surrender. Chen the regional commander and Xianyu the drill officer led the river flotilla out of the city and were overtaken and destroyed at Dafutan. Li Yan, prefect of Xuzhou, came up with reinforcements, turned back when he learned Jia Ding was lost and was beaten and captured at the Yangya River. After the city fell the Yuan court appointed Zan Wanshou to sign for the West Sichuan Branch of the Central Secretariat and granted him the name Shun.
kits: 本場戰爭裝備的主軸，是配重投石車這類以長臂配重甩出石彈的攻城砲。中國稱之為砲車、拋石車，蒙古西征時由回回砲手把配重式拋射機帶入西亞，隨軍東返後在中原與南宋江南的戰場上定型，宋人稱之為霹靂砲；宋端平二年（1231）蒙古軍攻饒州時已見其名，而元廷在至元十一年（1274）六月把砲手都元帥府改為回回砲手軍匠萬戶府，正是本戰役同年，說明配重砲已是一支常備的建制力量。卡面這具配重投石車代表的是十二世紀初在歐洲定型、並留下攻城記錄的那一型，其原理與中國自戰國以來、以《武經總要》所載砲車為代表的配重砲同源。嘉定之戰中，砲的用途與歐洲砲兵所熟悉的用法相同：石彈拋射打擊城牆、城樓與女牆，壓制城頭弓弩的射界，掩護步卒進逼城下，攻城序列上先發砲、再填壕搭梯。守方則以城頭砲車與弓弩反制，砲車成為城牆攻防的骨幹。除砲之外，決定此役勝負的還有大量工程與水軍裝備：石抹不老以七十艘巨艦載數千勇士，兼作浮動運輸與水上平台；紅崖灘浮橋把岷江水面切成兩段；懷遠寨、龍壩等寨壘卡住宋方水路增援。軍隊本身以弓矢為主，甲以皮甲、札甲為主，攻城另需長梯、撞車與填壕土石。糧秣同樣靠船：元軍食糧由岷江船隊自上游輸送，宋軍若失航線，守城撐不了多久。
kitsEn: The main line of equipment in this war is the counterweight trebuchet, the siege engine that throws a stone ball from the end of a long arm loaded with a counterweight. In China it was called the paoche or the throwing-stone engine; the Mongols carried counterweight artillery west in their campaigns, where Huihui (Central Asian) gunners operated it, and the machine travelled back east with the armies and settled on the battlefields of the Central Plain and of Southern Song Jiangnan, where the Chinese called it the thundering pao. It is already named in the records when the Mongols attacked Raozhou in 1231, the second year of the Duanping era, and in the sixth month of the eleventh year of Zhiyuan (1274), the year of this very campaign, the Yuan court renamed the Siege-Engines Marshal's Office the Office of the Huihui Artillery Master Troops, which shows that counterweight artillery had already become a standing institutional arm. The counterweight trebuchet on the card represents the type that took shape in Europe in the early twelfth century and left its own siege record; its principle is the same as that of the Chinese counterweight pao attested since the Warring States period and described in the Wujing Zongyao. In the siege of Jia Ding the engine was used exactly as European artillerymen knew it: stone balls were thrown against the curtain wall, the gate towers and the parapets to suppress the archers on the wall and cover the advance of the infantry, and in the assault sequence the artillery fired first, the sappers and ladder crews followed. The defenders answered with their own wall-mounted pao and with bows and crossbows, so that the siege engine was the backbone of the fight for the wall. Besides the artillery, a great deal of engineering and river equipment decided the outcome: Shimo Bulao's seventy large ships carried several thousand men and served at once as floating transport and as a water-borne platform; the pontoon bridge at Hongyatan cut the surface of the Min River into two; and stockades such as Huaiyuan and Longba blocked the Song water route for reinforcements. The troops themselves were armed mainly with bows and arrows and wore leather and lamellar armour, while the assault needed ladders, battering rams and the earth and stone used to fill the ditches. Supply came by boat as well: the Yuan army's grain was carried upriver by the Min River flotilla, and if the Song lost the river route the city could not be held for long.
tactics: 元軍的戰術是一套以工程與河流為骨架的圍城作業。步驟一，先以水軍打通上游：1274年石抹不老以七十艘巨艦載數千勇士順岷江而下，屯駐嘉定府上游，扼住宋軍自成都方向沿江運兵運糧的航路，部將旦只兒在夾江縣擊敗宋軍攔截，說明宋方曾試圖在江上遲滯元軍。步驟二，在平康城會師修寨：速哥率水軍抵平康城與也速帶兒會師，隨即修寨堅守，又另建懷遠寨扼守要衝，把臨時駐地變成可長期依託的據點。步驟三，清剿兩側高地：也速答兒率三千精兵至三龜、九頂山察看地形，擊敗宋軍、斬首五百級，切斷宋方所據的制高點。步驟四，架浮橋合圍：石抹不老在紅崖灘造浮橋，斷絕宋軍與外界聯繫，元軍渡過岷江完成對嘉定城的包圍，速哥守龍壩，堵住宋方由水路入援的通道。守方的部署是以山城為核心，昝萬壽依托三龜、九頂山兩處高地與江岸城垣構成互援，既不輕出也不放棄城外的制高點，雙方相持數月。攻勢轉折在1275年：二月萬戶禿滿答兒隨汪良臣攻九頂山，殺死宋都統侯興；五月汪良臣總攻，先斷言城外有伏兵，於城外山谷間大規模搜索並殲滅宋軍伏兵，再逼昝萬壽出戰，速哥自懷遠寨出擊，於麻平擊敗宋軍，宋軍損失慘重才派部將李立奉書請降。追擊同樣是戰術的一部分：陳都統與鮮于團練的水軍出逃，被速哥與石抹不老追至大佛灘全軍覆沒；知敘州李演的援軍聞嘉定已失，回撤途中於羊雅江遭元軍攻擊而被俘。
tacticsEn: The Yuan plan was a siege operation whose skeleton was engineering and the river. First, the fleet opened the upper reaches: in 1274 Shimo Bulao took seventy large ships and several thousand men down the Min River and stationed them above Jiading Prefecture, closing the water route by which the Song could move troops and grain down from Chengdu, and Dan Zhi'er beat a Song blocking force at Jiajiang county, which shows that the Song had tried to hold the invaders up on the water. Second, they met and entrenched at Pingkang: Suge brought the fleet to Pingkang to join Yesu Dair, entrenched there at once, and then built the Huaiyuan stockade astride the vital ground, turning a temporary halting place into a base that could be held for a long time. Third, they swept the flanking heights: Yesu Da'er took three thousand picked troops to Sankui and Jiudingshan to study the ground, beat the Song troops and took five hundred heads, and cut off the high ground the Song was holding. Fourth, they bridged the river and closed the ring: Shimo Bulao built a pontoon bridge at Hongyatan to sever the garrison from the outside world, the Yuan army crossed the Min River and completed the encirclement of Jiading, and Suge held Longba to close the water approach for Song relief. The defence was organised around the hill positions: Zan Wanshou relied on the heights of Sankui and Jiudingshan together with the river-bank city wall in a mutually supporting system, neither sallying out rashly nor giving up the high ground outside the walls, and the two sides stood off for several months. The turn came in 1275. In the second month the household commander Tumandara followed Wang Liangchen against Jiudingshan and killed the Song regional commander Hou Xing. In the fifth month Wang Liangchen led the general assault: suspecting ambushes outside the city, he searched the valleys beyond the walls on a large scale and destroyed the Song ambush force, then forced Zan Wanshou to give battle, Suge sallied out from the Huaiyuan stockade and beat the Song army at Maping, and only after heavy losses did the Song send the subordinate Li Li to offer surrender. The pursuit was part of the plan as well: the flotilla of Chen and Xianyu tried to escape and was run down by Suge and Shimo Bulao at Dafutan and destroyed; and the relief force of Li Yan, prefect of Xuzhou, turned back on learning that Jia Ding was lost, then was attacked on the way at the Yangya River and captured.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵船與時間兩端。兵船方面：1274年石抹不老以七十艘巨艦、載數千勇士沿岷江而下，佔據嘉定府上游；都元帥紐璘之子也速答兒投入三千精兵攻三龜、九頂山，斬首五百級。時間方面，圍城自1274年冬開啟，至1275年六月初一城破，前後約半年，續資治通鑑記為雙方相持數月。可互相對照的年表是：1274年十月元廷復置嘉定路與敘州宣撫司，以控川南蠻夷雜處之地；1275年正月樞密院奏請以璽書招諭嘉定等邊郡，從之；同年二月元軍殺宋都統侯興；五月汪良臣總攻、宋軍麻平失利；六月初一昝萬壽以嘉定、三龜、九頂、紫雲四城降元；其後陳都統與鮮于團練所領水軍在大佛灘覆沒，李演於羊雅江被俘。地理上，嘉定府城在今樂山，位於岷江、大渡河、青衣江三江匯流之處，東距三龜、九頂山數里，西去成都約一百五十公里；江面在城北一帶較寬而水流平緩，可行大船，冬季水量轉小，正是浮橋與巨艦同時展開的季節。編制上，元軍以萬戶、千戶、百戶分層，砲手另隸回回砲手軍匠萬戶府；宋軍以安撫司、都統司、軍馬司、團練分置，一府之兵分屯城、三龜、九頂山、龍壩等數處。傷亡與俘獲的精確數字史無明文，可確定的是宋都統侯興陣亡、部將李立出降、李演被俘，以及陳都統與鮮于團練所領水軍在大佛灘全軍覆沒。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked cluster at the two ends of the record, men and ships on one side and time on the other. On ships and troops: in 1274 Shimo Bulao came down the Min River with seventy large ships carrying several thousand men and occupied the upper reaches above Jiading Prefecture; Yesu Da'er committed three thousand picked troops against Sankui and Jiudingshan and took five hundred heads. On time: the siege opened in the winter of 1274 and the city did not fall until the first day of the sixth month of 1275, so the investment lasted about half a year, which the Xuwen Zizhi Tongjian records as the two sides holding each other off for several months. The sequence can be cross-checked: in the tenth month of 1274 the Yuan court restored the circuit of Jiading and the Pacification Commission of Xuzhou in order to control the border region where tribes and Han Chinese intermingled; in the first month of 1275 the Secretariat proposed sending sealed summons to Jia Ding and the other border prefectures and this was approved; in the second month the Yuan troops killed the Song regional commander Hou Xing; in the fifth month Wang Liangchen led the general assault and the Song army was beaten at Maping; on the first day of the sixth month Zan Wanshou surrendered Jiading, Sankui, Jiudingshan and Ziyun; afterwards the flotilla of Chen and Xianyu was destroyed at Dafutan and Li Yan was captured at the Yangya River. Geographically, the city of Jiading Prefecture stood at modern Leshan, where the Min, Dadu and Qingyi rivers meet; the heights of Sankui and Jiudingshan lay a few miles to the east and Chengdu was about one hundred and fifty kilometres to the west. The river above the city is broad and slow enough to carry large craft, and the winter low water was the season in which a pontoon bridge and a fleet could be worked at the same time. In organisation the Yuan army was layered into units of ten thousand, a thousand and a hundred men, with the artillery placed separately under the Office of the Huihui Artillery Master Troops, while the Song divided its command into pacification, regional command, army-horse and drill offices, and the troops of a single prefecture were quartered in several places at once, at the city, at Sankui, at Jiudingshan and at Longba. No exact casualty or prisoner figures survive; what is certain is that the Song regional commander Hou Xing was killed, that the subordinate Li Li came out to surrender, that Li Yan was taken prisoner, and that the flotilla of Chen and Xianyu was wiped out at Dafutan.
cause: 嘉定之戰的起因，是元朝在打通襄漢之後對南宋全面用兵，而南宋在四川南部僅存的堡壘必須拔除。1236年蒙古軍入蜀，川中州縣多陷，四川自此成為元宋拉鋸的主戰場；到1273年襄樊陷落，元軍取得漢水與江漢的樞紐，1274年元世祖下令大舉攻宋，東路由伯顏領步騎沿漢水順江而下，西路則由也速帶兒與汪良臣經西川收拾殘局。對元廷而言，嘉定是川南最後的堡壘，扼住由成都通向敘州、興元的陸路，又緊鄰岷江航線；只要控制嘉定與三龜、九頂山，西川與江南的陸路聯繫即被切斷，後方也能順著航道直下長江流域。對宋廷而言，四川已與兩淮、荊湖隔絕，臨安朝廷自1274年冬起急令各軍入衛，川南守軍只能就地死守。招降在先而兵戎在後：1275年正月元樞密院奏請以璽書招諭嘉定等六郡，朝廷從之，但宋方拒守，城池遂成為唯一選項。攻下嘉定還有一層戰略意義，它同時是蒙古水軍、漢軍工兵與配重砲兵聯合攻堅的一次實地演練，攻下此城，就等於為順江而下預先打開航路。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the Battle of Jia Ding was the general offensive Kublai Khan ordered against the Southern Song once the Yuan had opened the Xiangyang-Han river route, and the elimination of the last Song fortress in southern Sichuan. In 1236 the Mongols entered Sichuan and most prefectures fell, and from then on the province became the main contested ground between the two courts; when Xiangyang and Fancheng fell in 1273 the Yuan gained the hinge of the Han river and the middle Yangtze, and in 1274 the Yuan emperor ordered a general attack, Bayan leading foot and horse down the Han and the Yangtze in the east while Yesu Dair and Wang Liangchen closed out the western theatre through Sichuan in the west. For the Yuan court Jia Ding was the last bastion in the south of the province: it closed the land road from Chengdu to Xuzhou and Xingyuan and sat right beside the Min River navigation. To hold Jia Ding together with Sankui and Jiudingshan was to cut the land link between Sichuan and Jiangnan and to give the rear army a clear channel down the Yangtze. For the Song court Sichuan had been cut off from the Two Hua and from Jinghu, and from the winter of 1274 Lin'an was ordering every army back to the capital, so the troops in the south of Sichuan could only hold where they stood. Summons came before arms: in the first month of 1275 the Yuan Secretariat proposed sending sealed letters to Jia Ding and five other prefectures, the court agreed, but the Song refused and the siege was the only remaining option. Taking Jia Ding carried a second meaning as well. It was a field demonstration of a joint assault by the Mongol fleet, Han Chinese engineers and the counterweight artillery, and to take the city was to open the river road in advance of the drive down the Yangtze.
impact: 嘉定陷落改變了川東與江南的戰局，也改變了南宋在四川的抵抗結構。1275年六月初一昝萬壽以嘉定、三龜、九頂、紫雲四城降元，川南門戶洞開；宋廷在四川最後的縱深只剩下重慶一隅，張玨仍在重慶固守不下，直到1278年才被攻破，兩川自此分裂為元軍西線與宋軍孤城兩個戰區。戰略上，此役是元朝以船載兵、以浮橋與寨壘斷絕對手補給的樣板，東路伯顏同年二月在丁家洲大敗宋軍、進軍建康，兩路互為呼應，1276年臨安出降，元朝取得江南。元廷對降將的處置也留下影響：昝萬壽仍簽四川行樞密院事、賜名順，並未立即誅罰，使投降的守將仍掌兵柄，成為招降政策的示範；續資治通鑑記昝萬壽既降後兩川郡縣多送款，川南與川中各州縣於此後陸續望風而降，可見一次邊郡的陷落往往決定整片區域崩解的速度。技術層面的記錄同樣重要：元朝把砲手軍匠獨立編為萬戶府，反映配重拋射機已成為常備攻城力量；本役中浮橋、寨壘與七十艘巨艦先解決補給與交通，再由砲與突擊解決城頭，這條經驗與同年襄樊攻防中回回砲的運用落在同一條技術線上。
impactEn: The loss of Jia Ding changed the shape of the fighting in eastern Sichuan and in Jiangnan, and it changed the structure of the Song resistance in the province. On the first day of the sixth month of 1275 Zan Wanshou surrendered Jiading, Sankui, Jiudingshan and Ziyun, and the southern gate of Sichuan stood wide open. The Song court's last depth in Sichuan was reduced to the single corner of Chongqing, where Zhang Jue held out stubbornly until the city was taken in 1278; from then on the two Chinas were split into the Yuan western front and a lone Song city. Tactically the campaign became the model of an operation in which men were carried by boat, pontoon bridges and stockades were used to strangle the opponent's supply, and the two fronts supported one another: in the east Bayan crushed the Song at Dingjia Zhou in the second month of 1275 and advanced on Jiankang, and in 1276 Lin'an surrendered and the Yuan took the south of the river. The way the Yuan treated the surrendered commander had its own consequences. Zan Wanshou was put in charge of the West Sichuan Branch of the Central Secretariat and given the name Shun rather than being executed, so that a governor who had handed over his city kept his command, and this served as the demonstration of the policy of summoning rather than exterminating. The Xuwen Zizhi Tongjian records that after Zan's surrender many prefectures of the two Chinas sent in their submissions, and the towns of southern and central Sichuan followed one after another; a single frontier prefecture falling could therefore decide how quickly a whole region came apart. The technical record matters as much: the Yuan made the artillery masters and craftsmen a separate command of ten thousand men, which shows that the counterweight throwing engine had become a standing siege arm, and the experience of this campaign, in which a pontoon bridge, stockades and seventy large ships settled supply and movement before artillery and assault settled the wall, lies on the same technical line as the Huihui pao used at Xiangyang and Fancheng in the same years.
result: 嘉定之戰以元軍全勝告終。1275年五月汪良臣總攻之前，萬戶禿滿答兒已在二月攻九頂山、殺死宋都統侯興，拔掉了宋軍最外圍的一支主力；五月汪良臣先搜山殲滅宋軍伏兵，再逼昝萬壽出戰，速哥自懷遠寨出擊，於麻平擊敗宋軍，宋軍損失慘重，昝萬壽不得不派部將李立奉書請降。六月一日，昝萬壽以嘉定、三龜、九頂、紫雲四城降元，西川行院副使忽敦抵達，與也速帶兒在紅崖灘會師，速哥守住龍壩，堵住宋方最後的水路援軍。善後上，元廷授昝萬壽四川行樞密院事、賜名順；陳都統與鮮于團練率水軍出逃至大佛灘，被速哥與石抹不老追及，全軍覆沒；知敘州李演引兵來援，聞嘉定已失即撤，於羊雅江兵敗被俘。城雖拿下，元軍也付出了時間代價：自1274年冬渡江圍城到1275年六月初一城破，前後約半年，其間要靠浮橋、寨壘與七十艘巨艦維持對江面的控制，糧秣則全賴上游船運。城破之後，川南再無屏障可恃，張玨的重慶成為宋軍最後的堡壘之一，而元軍順著被打開的航線與道路把攻勢推向江南，1276年臨安降、1278年重慶陷落，宋元戰爭至此基本結束。
resultEn: The Battle of Jia Ding ended in a complete Yuan victory. Before Wang Liangchen's general assault in the fifth month of 1275, the household commander Tumandara had already attacked Jiudingshan in the second month and killed the Song regional commander Hou Xing, removing the outermost of the Song field formations. In the fifth month Wang Liangchen swept the hills and destroyed the Song ambush force, then forced Zan Wanshou to give battle; Suge sallied out of the Huaiyuan stockade and beat the Song army at Maping; the Song suffered heavy losses and Zan had to send his subordinate Li Li to offer a written surrender. On the first day of the sixth month Zan Wanshou surrendered Jiading, Sankui, Jiudingshan and Ziyun. Hu Dun, sub-commissioner of the West Sichuan branch, reached the field and joined Yesu Dair at Hongyatan, while Suge held Longba and closed the last water route by which Song relief could come. In the aftermath the Yuan court gave Zan Wanshou charge of the West Sichuan Branch of the Central Secretariat and the name Shun; Chen the regional commander and Xianyu the drill officer ran their flotilla down to Dafutan, were overtaken there by Suge and Shimo Bulao and were wiped out; and Li Yan, prefect of Xuzhou, came up with troops, turned back as soon as he learned Jia Ding was lost, and was beaten and captured at the Yangya River. The city was taken, but the Yuan had paid for it in time: from the crossing of the river in the winter of 1274 to the fall of the city on the first day of the sixth month of 1275 was about half a year, during which the pontoon bridge, the stockades and the seventy large ships had to hold the river, and all the grain came up the water from the north. Once the city was in Yuan hands there was no further barrier in southern Sichuan. Zhang Jue's Chongqing became one of the last Song strongholds, while the Yuan army, using the river and the roads it had opened, carried the war down into Jiangnan; Lin'an fell in 1276 and Chongqing in 1278, and with them the Song-Yuan war was essentially over.
